allies.rationale_text: Confirmation-bias strengthens representativeness-heuristic by reinforcing the first stereotype or prototype match and filtering out disconfirming evidence.
allies.source_quote: Representativeness often provides the initial, favored hypothesis or frame. Confirmation bias then reinforces this choice.
allies.affinity_rationale: Canonical: 'Representativeness often provides the initial, favored hypothesis. Confirmation bias then reinforces this choice, causing individuals to seek confirming evidence.'
allies.activation_condition: When an initial similarity-based judgment is reinforced by selective evidence seeking that confirms the representative categorization.

allies.rationale_text: Narratives makes representativeness-heuristic more seductive when a vivid story feels more diagnostic than the actual distribution of outcomes.
allies.source_quote: The fundamental essence of this mental model lies in the brain's preference for salient narratives over statistical realities.
allies.affinity_rationale: Canonical: 'Representativeness is fueled by WYSIATI and narrative coherence. A vivid story feels more diagnostic than the actual distribution of outcomes.'
allies.activation_condition: When story coherence and vividness make a scenario feel more probable than its actual base rate warrants.

antagonists.rationale_text: Base-rates directly counter representativeness-heuristic by forcing denominator discipline when vivid resemblance is doing the work of judgment.
antagonists.source_quote: Reference Class Forecasting uses historical outcomes from similar problems to predict the current outcome, thereby incorporating statistical reality.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Canonical: 'RH, by definition, ignores critical components of rational probability, such as the base rate and statistical laws' — definitional opposition.
antagonists.activation_condition: When resemblance-based categorization overrides the actual statistical frequency of events in the reference class.

antagonists.rationale_text: Bayesian updating resists representativeness-heuristic by revising on evidence instead of trusting intuitive category fit.
antagonists.source_quote: Mitigating the risks of RH involves deliberately engaging System 2 thinking to police the quick judgments of System 1.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Bayesian reasoning requires incorporating prior probabilities and updating with evidence — directly corrects the representativeness heuristic's neglect of base rates.
antagonists.activation_condition: When proper Bayesian updating would correct the intuitive probability estimate distorted by surface similarity.

antagonists.rationale_text: Critical-thinking opposes representativeness-heuristic by slowing the jump from resemblance to belief and demanding verification of missing evidence.
antagonists.source_quote: System 2 can be trained to think statistically and logically, enabling it to incorporate base rates and overcome the bias of representativeness.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Canonical: 'Critical thinking requires questioning one's mental models and actively seeking evidence that challenges them. RH promotes the opposite: defaulting to the familiar and confirmatory.'
antagonists.activation_condition: When deliberate critical analysis would reveal that the representative categorization is based on surface resemblance rather than structural evidence.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Representativeness-heuristic conflicts with base-rates when vivid similarity overrides reference-class frequency and outside-view distribution evidence.
structured_tensions.source_quote: representativeness-heuristic conflicts with base-rates (base rates) when vivid similarity overrides reference-class frequency.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Representativeness-heuristic conflicts with regression-to-the-mean when extreme outcomes are projected as persistent.
structured_tensions.source_quote: representativeness-heuristic conflicts with regression-to-the-mean (regression to the mean) when extreme outcomes are projected as persistent.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Representativeness-heuristic conflicts with narratives when narrative coherence makes a representative-seeming scenario feel more probable than its base rate warrants.
structured_tensions.source_quote: representativeness-bias conflicts with narratives (narratives) when narrative coherence makes a representative-seeming scenario feel more probable than its base rate warrants.

curation_notes.summary: Layer 1+2 enrichment complete. confirmation-bias 0.90 (reinforcement loop), narratives 0.90 (fueled by narrative coherence). base-rates and bayesian antagonists both at 0.95 (definitional opposition), critical-thinking at 0.90.
donor_drops: Did not preserve broader availability and outcome-bias sprawl beyond the clearest current-vocabulary corrections.

Bias-blind-spot is source-real pressure too, but the retained set favors the stronger current-vocabulary base-rate and confirmation neighborhood.
